messages:
mia.sales: Hey team — NebulaHealth (healthcare SaaS) wants a week-long POC next month. Main asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk import), RBAC mapping to our roles, and domain controls for multi-tenant onboarding. They also asked about pricing for a pilot (approx 1M tokens/mo + 10k active users). Need technical presales + security input.
raj.solutions: @mia.sales good call. Quick q: do they need JIT provisioning or full SCIM sync?
mia.sales: They said JIT for day-to-day, but a one-time bulk import for existing users. Also strict domain allowlist per tenant (multiple verified domains per org).
olivia.security: From security side, they flagged PHI concerns (HIPAA). They asked whether Redwood can be deployed in our Private option w/ customer-managed VPC and KMS/HSM. Also want SAML signed assertions and cert rotation policy.
dante.product: Private deployment yes — we have an on-prem option and VPC Private with KMS integrations. For the POC we can propose Dedicated if they want faster onboarding + reserved throughput.
jess.devex: For SCIM: we support incremental (delta) and full sync. Typical mapping example we give: `external_id -> user.externalId`, `emails[0].value -> user.email`, `groups -> roles` with an optional transform hook. For bulk import we usually accept CSV to our onboarding service or run a one-off SCIM full replace.
raj.solutions: Operational checklist I recommend for the POC: 1) SAML metadata exchange, 2) SCIM service account + sample mapping, 3) RBAC mapping doc, 4) domain verification steps, 5) test users + tokens. Also need to confirm whether they want SP-initiated only or IdP-initiated flows.
mia.sales: They're SP-initiated primarily.
olivia.security: We'll need to provide: SOC2 Type II report, HIPAA BA agreement draft, pen-test summary, cert expiry alerts. Also: do we support Signed Encrypted Assertions? They asked.
dante.product: We support signed assertions by default; encrypted assertions are supported on Private deployment (on-host key mgmt). For Hosted API we can work with encrypted assertions but need customer key material via KMS in Private.
sam.custsu: I'll prep common templates (BAA, SOC2 link). Also note: their SSO team will want `NameID` format = `emailAddress`.
jess.devex: Sample SAML metadata snippet for quick test:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://nebulahealth-idp.example">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://idp.nebula/sso"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
We can host a test SP metadata at our side.
raj.solutions: Pricing note for POC: if they want Dedicated for a month, propose a short-term reserved for pilot (1 GPU pool small) vs hosted pay-as-you-go. For 1M tokens/mo, hosted costs are predictable; but RBAC + SCIM automation + PHI will push them to Dedicated/Private and an enterprise support add-on.
mia.sales: They're price sensitive. They asked if SCIM and SSO are included or charged as integrations.
dante.product: SSO and SCIM are standard with enterprise license; Private deployment + KMS + extended retention or premium SLAs are add-ons. Document that in the quote.
olivia.security: Two security gotchas to flag: 1) SCIM provisioning scopes — ensure the service account has least privilege and can do PATCH for delta updates; 2) Domain verification: we should require DNS TXT verification to avoid cross-tenant claims hijack.
jess.devex: For RBAC mapping, we recommend mapping IdP groups -> Redwood roles with a default fallback role. Example mapping format we send in the POC: `idp:Engineering -> rw_developer`, `idp:Ops -> rw_infra_admin`, plus a `tenant_owner` claim mapping to a higher privilege.
raj.solutions: I'll draft the POC runbook and an artifacts list. Who can pair with me for the SAML/SCIM smoke test next Tue?
mia.sales: I can facilitate with NebulaHealth PM. @jess.devex can you own the mapping examples?
jess.devex: Yup, I can own that.
odm-bot: (This is a placeholder, ignore)
sam.custsu: I'll queue the BA template and coordinate the SOC2 link.
olivia.security: I can join the kickoff to review encryption and key management questions.
raj.solutions: Great. Action items: Mia — confirm pilot dates; Jess — mapping + sample SCIM CSV; Olivia — BA + key mgmt constraints; Dante — pricing blurb for Dedicated vs Hosted pilot; Sam — compliance artifacts.
mia.sales: Sending the intro to NebulaHealth now. Will update thread with their SAML metadata when received. :thumbsup:
